title: How the animation works
text: Observations keyframes. ggrace() lays uniform grid duration * fps time points across observed range interpolates entity’s value linearly onto . Two things follow. Bars grow steady rate rather easing every observation, read pulse per time step. grid uniform real time, keyframes, unevenly spaced observations play true relative speed instead gap taking number frames. entity absent time points bridged linearly observations exist. One absent ends holds nearest observed value, kept ranking missing.

what: Rank does not move at a constant rate
title: How the animation works
text: Rank treated differently, decision affects animation reads. Interpolating rank linearly two observations puts every overtaking bar motion whole time step, field size permanently drifting labels never settle. Instead, every frame ranked interpolated values, gives step function per entity, drawn position eases old rank new one swap seconds cubic curve. Bars therefore rest place change positions one short, deliberate move.  flat sections bar sitting still; short ramps swaps. Shorten swap snappier chart, lengthen slower one.
code: kenya <- subset(race$frames, name == "Kenya") plot(kenya$time, -kenya$rank, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#22928F",      xlab = "year", ylab = "position", yaxt = "n",      main = "One country's position through the race") axis(2, at = -(1:15), labels = 1:15, las = 1) sum(abs(diff(kenya$rank)) > 1e-8)  # frames spent moving #> [1] 55 nrow(kenya)                        # frames in total #> [1] 300
